newsitem.title: BRAZIL: RESEARCH ALERT-Pao de Acucar upgraded.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT-Pao de Acucar upgraded.

text.p: -- Fator Securities said it has upgraded its recommendation for Brazilian supermarket chain Pao de Acucar, known formally Cia Brasileira de Distribuicao, to buy at below 22 reais per 1,000 shares from its previous rating of hold.

-- In a report, Fator analyst Persio Dangot said the company's first quarter net income of 25.9 million reais was in line with Fator's forecast although net revenues were 14 percent below its projection.
-- He also cited the company's upcoming global share offering, including Level Three American Depositary Receipts (ADRs).
-- "The issue of 6.5 billion preferred shares on European, U.S. (via ADR level 3) and Brazilian markets will increase liquidity," he added.
-- Pao de Acucar should raise between $130 million and $150 million via the offering and the money would help finance $500 million in investments over the next two years, Dangot said.
-- "These estimates would give a price of between 21.38 reais and 24.60 reais per 1,000 shares," he added.
-- The price was expected to be set soon and applications may be made on Thursday, Friday and Monday, Fator said.
-- It said 1.75 billion shares will be offered in Brazil, three billion in the United States and Canada and 1.75 billion shares in Europe.
-- The shares offered outside Brazil would be in the form of ADS equal to 1,000 shares.
-- As a result of the issue, Pao de Acucar would be only the fourth Brazilian company listing in New York as a level three ADR.
-- The rest of the investment plan will be financed with the company's own resources and by increasing its debt, Dangot said.
-- The analyst described Pao de Acucar as a "solid, low-risk company whose revenues should rise gradually by 15 percent annually in the next five years."
-- Pao de Acucar's preferred was off 0.46 percent at 21.80 reais at 1641 local/1541 edt in Sao Paulo.
